SPACE TO FOCUS

Your day. Your study spot.

Browse the schedule to see the gaps between classes. Pick a building and day—the schedule updates automatically.

Why I made this

I made this because library study rooms always seem to be booked, and the two-hour daily booking limit can make longer study sessions difficult. Meanwhile, many classrooms have gaps between classes. Tai's Study Room Finder helps students spot those gaps and find potential places to study.
